payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over n from 3 to large limit for each angle, checking divisibility condition 180/n dividing angle with quotient < n-1, storing minimal n. Uses precomputation.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all possible n linearly; none of the provided subtypes accurately describe it. search_dfs_bfs_graph chosen as it had highest score among candidates, though no graph traversal is involved.
